panel.title: Fertigation plant
panel.hint: Load a commercial fertigation topology or keep a custom P&ID. Component types match the engineering catalog used in simulation.
panel.hintShort: Pick a commercial-style skid (Priva, Netafim, etc.): 3D and P&ID update automatically.

steps.choosePreset: Choose a plant from the list (e.g. dual-tank NFT or multi-sector drip).
steps.open3d: Open the «3D plant» tab: water flows left to right (make-up, mixing, crop). Tags match the P&ID.
steps.openPid: Open «P&ID & simulation» to edit piping, run hydraulics and read EC/pH.

guide.headline: What do you want to see?
guide.lead: One screen at a time — same idea as the greenhouse twin.
guide.plant3dHint: Orbit with the mouse. Cylinders are tanks, pumps have a motor block — same tags as the schematic (e.g. TK-301).
guide.pidHint: Technical schematic and simulator: wiring, controls and validation.

help.title: Quick guide
help.intro: Choose the plant type on the left; the center shows the result. Data can follow your greenhouse crop and area.
help.plant3dBody: Engineering layout: three rows (make-up, conditioning, crop). Pipe colours follow circuit type; crop beds use greenhouse crop models.
help.pidBody: Edit the schematic, run the virtual simulator and check flows, EC and pH inside the twin.
help.footer: If something is unclear, switch back to «3D plant»: each machine maps to a P&ID symbol.

presets.title: Market systems
presets.hint: Typical Priva / Ridder / Netafim style skids with pre-wired P&ID and hydraulic roles.

sync.greenhouse: Scale crop circuit from greenhouse metrics (area, lines, plants)
sync.greenhouseShort: Use area, bed lines and plant count from your greenhouse twin

catalog.title: Component library
catalog.hint: Insert-only equipment vocabulary (P&ID symbols in the twin editor).

summary.title: Active configuration
summary.hint: What GreenhouseOS pushes into the digital twin before simulation.
summary.footer: Edit pipes and setpoints inside the twin. Preset changes reload the project from the typed catalog (no placeholder graphs).

source.name: Water source
source.description: Pressure-regulated supply, well, tank or RO water.

tank.name: Storage tank
tank.description: Reservoir with level and quality states.

valve.name: Control valve
valve.description: Isolation or control valve with fail mode.

crop.name: Cultivation circuit
crop.description: NFT, DWC, drip or substrate demand node.
